name_zh: 香港國際機場一號客運大樓
coord_source: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, way 772085062 (aeroway=terminal, Terminal 1), building centroid, not a specific door
address_en: Terminal 1, Hong Kong International Airport, Chek Lap Kok, Lantau Island, Hong Kong
hours_note: Immigration Department lists the HKIA Terminal 1 control point as open 24 hours (Terminal 2 control point: 05:15 to 00:15 next day). Shops, restaurants, lounges and Airport Express each have their own hours, which are not covered here.

name_en: The Peak Tram – Garden Road Lower Terminus
hours_note: Operator pages state 7:30 am to 11 pm (Mon-Sun & public holidays); the terms of service state the last tram departs at 11:00 pm. Service is suspended for typhoon signal / black rainstorm and for scheduled maintenance (announced in advance on thepeak.com.hk and in Transport Department notices).

fee.note: Adult single HK$82, adult return HK$116 (child 3-11 / senior 65+: HK$52 single, HK$75 return), per the operator's ticket page as indexed by search (direct fetch blocked) and Time Out's Jan 2026 fare-rise report. Tram + Sky Terrace 428 combo: adult HK$146 single, HK$182 return.

closures: none found for January 2027 (recent maintenance suspensions: 26-30 May 2025, 9-12 Mar 2026, 8 Sep 2026)

name_en: Sky Terrace 428 (The Peak Tower, Victoria Peak)
address_en: Rooftop, The Peak Tower, Victoria Gap (The Peak), Hong Kong
hours_note: CONFLICT on the operator's own site: product/ticket/webstore pages give 8:30 am to 10 pm daily (reported as effective from 1 May 2026); the ticket terms of service still give 10:00-22:00 Mon-Fri and 08:00-22:00 Sat/Sun/PH. 08:30-22:00 is used here as the newer schedule. Last admission: not published (unverified). Closes for typhoon signal / black rainstorm.

fee.note: Standalone adult HK$80 (child/senior HK$50) is from secondary guides only, not confirmed on the official site. Official combo with Peak Tram: adult HK$146 single, HK$182 return.

name_en: Star Ferry – Tsim Sha Tsui Pier (Central–Tsim Sha Tsui route)
name_zh: 天星小輪尖沙咀碼頭（中環－尖沙咀航線）
coord_source: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, relation 14941144 (amenity=ferry_terminal 'Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier')
address_en: Star Ferry Pier, Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: First and last sailings 06:30 and 23:30 from both Central and Tsim Sha Tsui, every day. TST departures: Mon-Fri 06:30-07:15 every 10/12 min, 07:15-09:45 every 6 min, 09:45-20:30 every 6/8 min, 20:30-23:30 every 10/12 min; Sat/Sun/PH 06:30-07:15 every 10/12 min, 07:15-22:30 every 6/8 min, 22:30-23:30 every 10/12 min.

fee.note: Adult, valid to 24 Jan 2027: Mon-Fri upper deck HK$5.0 / lower deck HK$4.0; Sat, Sun & PH upper HK$6.5 / lower HK$5.6. So Thu 21 and Fri 22 Jan use weekday fares, Sat 23 and Sun 24 Jan weekend fares. New fares start 25 Jan 2027 (adult capped at HK$6.0 weekday / HK$8.3 weekend), i.e. the day after the trip.

name_en: Avenue of Stars / Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade
name_zh: 星光大道（尖沙咀海濱長廊）
address_en: Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade, Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: The official Avenue of Stars site publishes no opening hours; 24 hours is from secondary listings, and LCSD lists the 'Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade (Designated Area)' as 24 hours daily. A SYMPHONY OF LIGHTS IS NOT RUNNING DURING THE TRIP: the Tourism Commission states the grand finale was held on 18 Nov 2026 (previously nightly 20:00, about 10 min). WinterFest light shows (Central, TST, Causeway Bay) run only until 5 Jan 2027; HKTB says new light shows come 'in 2027' with no dates announced.
closures: none found for the promenade; A Symphony of Lights permanently ended 18 Nov 2026

coord_source: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, node 4780310523 (tourism=attraction 'Temple Street'), southern market section near Jordan Road
address_en: Temple Street between Nanking Street and Kansu Street, Jordan / Yau Ma Tei, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: No operator publishes market opening hours. 14:00-23:00 is the FEHD permitted operating hours of the hawker stalls (LegCo paper, Jan 2017); individual stalls choose their own times. The Jordan Road-Kansu Street section is a part-time pedestrian precinct 14:00-24:00 daily, and government guides say the market is busiest from about 18:00-19:00 to 23:00.

address_en: Tung Choi Street between Argyle Street and Dundas Street, Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: No operator publishes market opening hours. 12:00-23:00 is the FEHD permitted operating hours of the 578 licensed hawker stalls in this Hawker Permitted Place (LegCo paper, Jan 2017); stalls are assembled each morning and dismantled at night, and individual stall times vary.

name_zh: 中環至半山自動扶梯及行人道系統
coord_source: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, northernmost (lower) point of the ways named 'Central-Mid-Levels Escalator System' (way 723375022), near Central Market / Queen's Road Central
address_en: Lower end at Queen's Road Central (near Central Market), upper end at Conduit Road, Central, Hong Kong
hours_note: Direction schedule (Transport Department): 06:00-10:00 runs one-way DOWNHILL; 10:00-24:00 runs one-way UPHILL; every day. Some third-party guides give 10:20 or 10:30 for the uphill switch; the official 10:00 is used. Individual escalator sections are sometimes suspended for repair or refurbishment.

address_en: 124-126 Hollywood Road, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong

date_exceptions.reason: Day 15 of the 12th lunar month (Hong Kong Observatory calendar); official lunar day 1/15 hours

hours_note: Regular service hours 08:00-18:00; on lunar calendar day 1 and day 15 and festival days 07:00-18:00. Fri 22 Jan 2027 is lunar day 15, so the temple opens at 07:00 that day.

address_en: 38 Museum Drive, West Kowloon Cultural District, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: Closed Mondays (also when a public holiday falls on Monday). Last admission 30 minutes before closing. Closes if Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above is hoisted. Fri 22 Jan 2027 is a late-opening day (to 22:00).

fee.note: M+ Ticket standard HK$190; concession HK$100 (students, children 7-11, seniors 60+, people with disabilities plus one companion, CSSA recipients); age 6 and below free.

name_en: Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple
coord_source: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, way 264462808 (amenity=place_of_worship 'Wong Tai Sin Temple'), centroid
address_en: 2 Chuk Yuen Village, Wong Tai Sin, Kowloon, Hong Kong
hours_note: Temple 07:30-16:30 daily (in effect since 1 Jun 2020). General Office, Good Wish Garden and Taisui Yuenchen Hall 08:00-16:30. Some third-party sites claim extended hours (to 21:00) on lunar day 1 and day 15, and Fri 22 Jan 2027 is lunar day 15, but the official site does not state this: treat any extension as unverified.

fee.note: Temple free. Taisui Yuenchen Hall HK$100 (half price for 65+ and people with disabilities).

coord_source: Official Maxim's Chinese brand page 'View map' link (22.282423, 114.161929), rounded to 5 decimals; OSM node 4701372989 gives 22.28261, 114.16158
address_en: 2/F, Low Block, Hong Kong City Hall, 5 Edinburgh Place, Central, Hong Kong
hours_note: Sun and public holidays open from 09:00 (Mon-Sat from 11:00). CONFLICT: the LCSD City Hall page (last revised 24 Feb 2022) gives dinner until 22:30; the operator's own brand page gives 23:00 and is used here. Time Out (secondary) says trolley dim sum is served in the lunch session only. Phone 2521 1303.
